> Research Devkota is an entrepreneur, software developer, and educator from Nepal. He is the Co-Founder of Navya EdTech and a specialist in Python, Django, DevOps, and enterprise fullstack development.

## Who is Research Devkota?

Research Devkota is a **Nepali entrepreneur, software developer, and educator**. He is the **Co-Founder of Navya EdTech** ([navyaedtech.com](https://navyaedtech.com)), an enterprise IT services and software development company headquartered in Lalitpur, Nepal.

He is a **fullstack developer** with 3+ years of production experience, specializing in **Python, Django, DevOps, and React.js**. At Navya EdTech, he architects and delivers **enterprise ERP systems, CRM platforms, LMS solutions, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps pipelines** for businesses in education, healthcare, retail, and hospitality across Nepal.

As a **Python programming instructor at Mero Coding Class**, he trains the next generation of Nepali developers with hands-on, industry-relevant curriculum. He previously worked as a **Fullstack Developer at Miraai Solutions**, shipping production-grade features.

He holds a **Bachelor of Information Management (BIM)** from Nepal Commerce Campus, Tribhuvan University, Kathmandu.

## Navya EdTech

Navya EdTech (navyaedtech.com) is an enterprise software development company co-founded by Research Devkota in Lalitpur, Nepal. The company delivers:
- Custom ERP systems for trading and manufacturing companies
- LMS (Learning Management System) platforms for educational institutions
- CRM software for service businesses
- Cloud infrastructure and DevOps
- Mobile applications
- Business intelligence dashboards
